title: TSL: Social Conflict
description: Social scenes for D&D 5e and Level Up (a5e): target an NPC, say your line, and pick what it really is — Demand, Appeal or Bargain to ask; Blackmail, Seduce or Deceive to go all in; or read them first. Every NPC has a hidden psychological nature that decides how it lands: the approach that opens them, the one they close against, the price they name, the emotion they leave on you when you miss. Masks that hide who they are, witnesses who make every yes binding and every no a disgrace, five emotions from Thirsty Sword Lesbians on everyone, scars that stay, Strings and bonds that carry into the campaign. In English and Ukrainian. Inspired by Thirsty Sword Lesbians (Powered by Lesbians).
